description: ONSAS provides an open structural-analysis solver for GNU Octave and MATLAB. Its contributors developed the first version for teaching nonlinear structural analysis at Universidad de la República and publish it for static or dynamic, linear or nonlinear calculations. The repository illustrates deployable structures, a propeller and a truss tower. Coverage depends on the user-defined structure and loading case, with no fixed geographic domain or historical observation period. Numerical detail and simulation duration follow the configured model. GitHub distributes source releases and examples under GPL-3.0, allowing free code reuse. The README recommends GNU Octave and ParaView for the documented workflow, while MATLAB is another supported environment with its own licence requirements. A limitation of this review is that available examples and documentation do not establish performance for a proposed engineering design. ONSAS can support structural response studies and comparison of model assumptions. Related record model-opensees offers another structural-analysis system. No software was installed and no numerical benchmark was reproduced.
